behavior: Owner::track_reserved requires a GpuReservation, whose constructor reserves global GPU capacity before API creation. Existing generation and local/process subcaps remain attached. Record capacity derives from the reservation instead of an independent byte argument.

Splitting a batch reservation assigns capacity to each allocation while sharing its permits. The entire admitted batch remains charged until the final participating allocation/submission retires, regardless of mapped-buffer retirement order. Refused oversized splits leave admitted capacity unchanged.

limits: Batch charging is conservative: retired siblings remain reserved until the last participant retires. Individual live records report their own capacity; reserved capacity can exceed live capacity.

This strengthens admission and lifetime ownership; it does not prove complete ACC-01 requested payload/reference incidence/release-reason reporting, CPU tracking metadata, construction/staging peaks or full MEM-GPU-TOTAL qualification. No predicate closure or inventory-count change.
